correctness.rationale: The quantified bound uses exact Radon Birkhoff arithmetic-chord constraints 1≤a,b≤1+τ and a+b≤2+τ, deduced from Birkhoff orthogonality and the independently identified published theorem A_2^B≤3/2. Convexity of s↦s^t for t≥1 proves a^t+b^t≤1+(1+τ)^t. A fixed hexagonal ordered orthogonal pair attains both endpoints simultaneously for all τ. Log-derivative and monotone T(τ) prove a unique global maximizer. Compactness and equality in the chord bound yield the iff hexagon rigidity. The quadratic constant and limit follow algebraically and via a uniform Lipschitz argument. A standalone checker passed 5,942 finite checks, not used as an infinite proof. The external Radon arithmetic-chord theorem is explicitly a premise.
